[EN] The Atel Akaad reinforce their ranks with Lokian bloodchargers and bloodmaguses.

We can't afford to let them marshal their strength. Take them out with the utmost dispatch!
[ES] Los Atel Akaad refuerzan sus filas con Lokian bloodchargers y bloodmaguses.

No podemos darnos el lujo de dejar que acumulen fuerzas. ¡Elimínalos con la máxima rapidez!

[EN] Your skill gives me hope. I suspect Killian is keeping us at bay because the timing of his scheme is delicate.

That tells me what we need to do. Keep hitting them!
[ES] Tu habilidad me da esperanza. Sospecho que Killian nos mantiene a raya porque el momento de su plan es delicado.

Eso me dice lo que tenemos que hacer. ¡Sigue golpeándolos!
